issues.jp_before: 渡[わた]り鳥[どり]{は|wa-topic}天候[てんこう]{を問[と]わず/にかかわらず|wotowazu}、決[き]まった時期[じき]{に|ni-time}同[おな]じ場所[ばしょ]{に|ni-destination}戻[もど]ってきます。
issues.problem: Non-focus destination slot with 戻ってくる also accepts へ, but the alternative was missing.

issues.jp_before: このキャンプ場[じょう]{は|wa-topic}人数[にんずう]{を問[と]わず/にかかわらず|wotowazu}、一泊[いっぱく]{の|no-possessive}料金[りょうきん]{は|wa-topic}同[おな]じです。
issues.problem: Distractor に関して/について gives 人数に関して料金は同じです ('as for the number of people, the price is the same'), which means nearly the same as the English. The second topic slot is also fine with が, but that alternative was missing.
issues.action: Distractors changed to に応じて, にとって, として. Second slot changed to {は/が|wa-topic}.

issues.jp_before: この高校[こうこう]{の|no-possessive}野球部[やきゅうぶ]{は|wa-topic}学年[がくねん]{を問[と]わず/にかかわらず|wotowazu}、実力[じつりょく]{の|no-possessive}ある人[ひと]{が|ga-subject}レギュラー{に|ni-change}なれます。
issues.problem: Distractor に関して gives 学年に関して ('as far as school year goes'), which can be read as 'year is not a factor' and comes too close to the answer.
issues.action: Distractors changed to に応じて, にとって, として.

issues.jp_before: 気分[きぶん]{の|no-possessive}良[よ]し悪[あ]し{にかかわらず|nikakawarazu}、毎日[まいにち]日記[にっき]{を|o-object}書[か]いています。
issues.problem: Distractors について/に関して produce a natural sentence ('I write in my diary every day about whether my mood is good or bad'), which is too plausible for a distractor.
issues.action: Distractors changed to にとって, として, に対して.

issues.jp_before: 母[はは]{は|wa-topic}成績[せいせき]{にかかわらず|nikakawarazu}、私[わたし]{が|ga-subject}頑張[がんば]ったこと{を|o-object}ほめてくれます。
issues.problem: Distractors に関して/について produce a grammatical, near-natural sentence ('about my grades, my mother praises my effort').
issues.action: Distractors changed to に応じて (a real learner confusion; it clearly flips the meaning), にとって, として.
